name: teamboundary-ai
description: A security-first multi-tenant AI workspace built entirely on Cloudflare.

scripts.ai:gate:disable: node scripts/prepare-d1-gate-config.mjs && wrangler d1 execute CONTROL_DB --remote --command "UPDATE deployment_limits SET ai_enabled=0 WHERE id=1" --config dist/teamboundary_gate_control/wrangler.json
scripts.ai:gate:enable: npm run prepare:deploy && wrangler d1 execute CONTROL_DB --remote --command "UPDATE deployment_limits SET ai_enabled=1 WHERE id=1" --config dist/teamboundary_target_control/wrangler.json
scripts.ai:gate:status: node scripts/prepare-d1-gate-config.mjs && wrangler d1 execute CONTROL_DB --remote --command "SELECT ai_enabled FROM deployment_limits WHERE id=1" --config dist/teamboundary_gate_control/wrangler.json
scripts.check: npm run boundary && npm run license:check && npm run license:bundle:check && npm run migration:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:run && npm run build && npm run dist:check && npm run deployment:check
scripts.migration:remote:apply: npm run prepare:deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply CONTROL_DB --remote --config dist/teamboundary_target_control/wrangler.json
scripts.migration:remote:list: npm run prepare:deploy && wrangler d1 migrations list CONTROL_DB --remote --config dist/teamboundary_target_control/wrangler.json
scripts.test:run: vitest run --config vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config vitest.workers.config.ts
